summary: CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI Petition No. 571/RC/2026 Coram: Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member Date of Order: 26th October, 2026 In the matter of Regulatory Compliance Application in terms of Regulation 15(1)(E) Of the CERC (Conduct of Business) Regulations 2023 read with Section 79 Of the Electricity Act, 2003 seeking change in name of the Transmission Licensee From “Pachora Power Transmission Limited” to “Pachora Power Transmission Private Limited”. And In the matter of Pachora Power Transmission Limited, Urjanidhi, First Floor, 1, Barakhamba Lane, Connaught Place, New Delhi- 110001. Petitioner VERSUS 1. Central Transmission Utility of India Limited, Shram Shakti Bhawan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi - 110001. 2. REC Power Development & Consultancy Limited, D-Block, REC Headquarter Plot No. I-4, Sector-29 Gurgaon - 122001. 3. Chhattisgarh State Power Transmission Company Limited, P.O. Sunder Nagar, Danganiya, Raipur - 492013, Chhattisgarh. 4. Chhattisgarh State Power Generation Company Limited, P.O. Sunder Nagar, Danganiya, Raipur - 492013, Chhattisgarh. 5. Chhattisgarh State Power Distribution Company Limited, P.O. Sunder Nagar, Danganiya, Raipur - 492013, Chhattisgarh Order in Petition No. 571/RC/2026 Page 1 (e) Pass any such further/other orders that this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit in the interest of equity and justice.” 2. By order dated 15.6.2024 in Petition No. 108/TL/2024, Pachora Power Transmission Limited (PPTL) was granted an inter-State transmission licence bearing Licence No. 128/Transmission/2024/CERC, for the establishment of the Transmission system for Evacuation of Power from RE Projects in Rajgarh (1000 MW) SEZ in Madhya Pradesh-Phase II. 3. The Petitioner has submitted that an application under Section 14(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 41 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014 was filed before the Regional Director (WR), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Mumbai, seeking approval for the conversion of the company into a Private Limited Company, which was duly approved vide Order dated 26.5.2026 by the Regional Director. Thereafter, the Regional Director sanctioned the alteration of Clause I of the Memorandum of Association, from “Pachora Power Transmission Limited” to “Pachora Power Transmission Private Limited”. 4. Subsequently, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs also issued a Certificate of Incorporation dated 30.6.2026 consequent upon conversion to a private company, duly recording the aforesaid conversion. 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, consequent to the change in name of the transmission licensee, there has been no change in the composition or structure of the company. Analysis and Decision 6. This Petition is being decided by way of circulation. Order in Petition No. 571/RC/2026 Page 5 7. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and perused the documents available on record. The Petitioner was granted the transmission licence vide order dated 15.6.2024 in Petition No. 108/TL/2024. 8. Consequent to the issuance of the certificate dated 30.6.2026 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, as noted above, we direct that the name of the Transmission Licensee be changed from “Pachora Power Transmission Limited” to “Pachora Power Transmission Private Limited” in the records of the Commission. It is further stipulated that Pachora Power Transmission Private Limited shall remain unequivocally bound by the terms and conditions of the inter-State transmission licence originally granted to Pachora Power Transmission Limited, provisions of the Transmission Service Agreement, Transmission Licence Regulations, and the Electricity Act, 2003. 9. We direct that the necessary endorsement be made on the transmission licence with regard to the change of name of “Pachora Power Transmission Limited” to “Pachora Power Transmission Private Limited”. Except for the name, there shall be no change in the terms and conditions of the licence. 10. Let an extract copy of this order be sent to the Central Government (the Ministry of Power), the Central Electricity Authority, and the Central Transmission Utility of India Limited in terms of sub-section (7) of Section 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003, for their information and record. 11. Accordingly, Petition No. 571/RC/2026 is allowed in terms of the above. Sd/- sd/- sd/- sd/- (Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson Order in Petition No. 571/RC/2026 Page 6 CERC Website S. No. 533/2026
